name: Reconcile provider self-profile caller with the existing owner-authorized profile

POST /v1/provider/dashboard.reason: Scanner POST declaration has no business authority or contract. The actual self-profile caller performs GET and now uses the existing canonical owner-scoped profile operation.
evidence: packages/flutter_core/lib/provider_service.dart: getSelfProfile validates the canonical profile envelope and propagates failures
packages/flutter_core/lib/src/network/api_client.dart: providerProfile and legacy providerDashboard config keys target the canonical GET; owner profile transport bypasses cache and mocks
cloudflare/workers/src/provider-self.ts: profile read uses authenticated user and tenant ownership; no new authority is introduced
scripts/reconcile-provider-profile-declaration.py: exact canonical identity, authority, schema, caller and incoming-reference guards preserve an atomic retirement tombstone
packages/flutter_core/test/provider_profile_test.dart: actual transport and service routing, DTO and failure regression coverage
